notes.title: Happy Z-mas
notes.notes:
Santa doesn’t care about cookies and milk, he will need some guns and ammo! Our zombie-shooting rebels wishes you a Merry Christmas!

If you need a break from this holidays jingle bells and whatnot, get into the zombie-apocalypse mode. Try saving the world from zombies using your helicopter. We are giving away one key per day for our Zordix Publishing games on our [url=https://twitter.com/ZordixPublish]Twitter @zordixpublish, so follow us for a chance to win!
[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix (v1.0.3 - 11/12/20)
notes.notes:
Yesterday the first hotfix patch for Dustoff Z went live!

This patch contains the following bug fixes:
[list]
[*] “Scrap them all” achievement.
[*] Distance count at the endless levels.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We are working on further patch updates focusing on a few more reported bugs.

If you have any issues to report feel free to contact our support directly by sending an email to support@zordixpublishing.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38312351/919cf642d6aba490ca31e70fd1d6b29aae68e438.png[/img]

notes.title: Launch date set for October 15th
notes.notes:
We are super excited to share the news that Zordix Publishing and Invictus Games today announced that Dustoff Z will be released the 15th October 2020!

Some gaming sites have already published some awesome articles: 

https://www.gonintendo.com/stories/368894-dustoff-z-takes-to-the-skies-on-switch-october-15th-2020
https://invisioncommunity.co.uk/dustoff-z-releasing-on-october-15th/
https://fullsync.co.uk/dustoff-z-takes-to-the-sky-october-15th/

Join the helicopter mayhem 15th October!
